properties.chose: (b), Anthony's word 2026-10-20 "Go with your recommendations": a test whose α, hypothesis, chosen test or re-run α moved after its data reads unknown ("its criteria moved after the data") until the owner acknowledges the criteria_changed_after_data gap with a reason; once acknowledged it reads as before. Nothing is refused: every write still lands. Not (a): a warning alone lets a moved goalpost support a claim. Not (c): judging at the original α would also unsay an honest correction (a typo in α) with no way back, where (b) costs one acknowledgement. Built in P6 as req:a-test-whose-criteria-moved-after-its-data-reads-unknown-until-acknowledged. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.decision: OPEN, for Anthony. As built on feat/hypothesis-tests (2026-10-19), a criterion changed after a test's data (α, the hypothesis, the chosen test, or the record re-run at another α) is REPORTED — the criteria_changed_after_data gap and test_reading.criteria_changed, both values and dates — and the test still reads "supported at α". The requirement says "reported … nothing is refused". Options: (a) keep it report-only (as built); (b) the test reads unknown ("its criteria moved after the data") until the owner acknowledges the gap with a reason, so a moved goalpost never supports a claim silently; (c) it reads supported at the ORIGINAL α only (the lock's), so a test that passes only under the moved α reads not rejected. Counter-argument to (b)/(c): a legitimate correction (a typo in α, a hypothesis reworded without changing its meaning) would unsay a valid result until someone acknowledges it.
properties.name: SETTLED 2026-10-20: a criterion changed after the data stops the test counting until the owner acknowledges the change with a reason (option b)
